description: Search one engine you choose and return its ranked web results. Use it when the engine matters (Yandex for Russian, Baidu for Chinese, Google for the widest index) or to page with start. If any engine will do, use any_search; to compare engines, use mega_search. Returns JSON: results (rank, title, url, snippet, domain, engine), pagination (has_more, next_start) and meta (request_id, took_ms, engines_failed). Cloud: 1 credit per 10 returned results. Errors return isError with status, error code and retry_after. On 429 or 503 wait retry_after; if an engine is blocked (CAPTCHA, 502/503), try another engine. Unsupported parameters return 400 and are not charged.

date.description: Published-date range YYYYMMDD..YYYYMMDD. Cloud web search supports Google and Ecosia; unsupported filters return 400 without charge.

engine.description: Engine to query: google, bing, yandex, baidu, duckduckgo (or duck), ecosia.

extract.description: Enrich the top web results with cleaned page content. Boolean or integer depth: false/0 off, true/1 top result, N top N (1-5).

extractMode.description: auto (default): fast HTTP fetch, browser render if the page comes back empty. fast: HTTP only. rendered: always a browser, for JavaScript-heavy pages.

features.description: Add serp_features (AI summary, answer box, People Also Ask, related searches) when the engine shows them.

file.description: File extension filter, such as PDF.

filter.description: Let the engine collapse near-duplicate results (default true, mostly affects Google).

format.description: json (default) for structured results; markdown, text or ndjson for compact plain text.

lang.description: Language code, such as EN or de.

limit.description: Maximum result count, 1-100. Keep 10 when paging with start.

minRunes.description: Minimum text length (in runes) before auto mode escalates to a browser render. 0 uses the built-in floor.

region.description: Market or location hint, such as US, DE, en-GB, Berlin, or a Yandex lr id.

start.description: Result offset. On Cloud, Google/Bing/Yandex use multiples of 10, Baidu supports early pages, Ecosia any offset, DuckDuckGo none. Balanced mega requires 0; unsupported offsets return 400.

text.description: Search query text. At least one of text, site, or file should be provided.

name: search
title: Search
